body: I had the pleasure of being a guest on W*USA TV last Thursday. Director Bill Rayment was once again a delight to work with, and Andrea Roane was as charming and engaging as ever. It’s a good thing when news media report on religious life … and not just when there’s a scandal or tragedy. Thanks, W*USA!
